scope: Dedicated continuous four-story v9 Rig screen demo only; normal candidate runtime remains inactive.

accepted_regression_contract.preserve: Source-component micro-motion is visibly legible on the physical e-paper panel; it uses one boot full baseline only and later partial-or-hold updates with no whole-face timeline.
accepted_regression_contract.not_accepted_as_final_runtime_behavior: A deterministic four-direction showcase loop without real attention/event selection reads as random and must not be promoted as the product behavior engine.

next_gate: Version event/state-bound previews for the remaining registered stories before changing the accepted physical Daily component-motion contract; charging and error remain fail-closed until separately approved art components exist.
